Accenture to Pay $25 Million to Settle US Discrimination Claims

Accenture has agreed to pay $25 million to resolve allegations of discrimination brought by the U.S. Department of Justice. The claims centered on the company's diversity, equity, and inclusion (DEI) initiatives during the Trump administration. This settlement follows similar agreements by other consulting firms, including Deloitte and IBM, which have collectively paid $63 million to settle related claims. The settlement amount for Accenture is specifically tied to allegations of discrimination.
